data.title: The minimum number of transfers is an exact search over subsets for up to 16 participants with a non-zero balance; beyond that, a greedy calculation marked isMinimal: false
data.description: The problem is NP-hard; O(2ⁿ·n) at n = 16 takes about 15 ms, and every next person doubles the search; the interface honestly says when the minimum is not guaranteed
